blocks.html: Robinsons Homes, one of the four residential brands of leading property developer Robinsons Land Corporation, recently held its annual Sales Kickoff Event entitled Elevate: Robinsons Homes Sales Rally 2017 in Crowne Plaza Galleria Manila. Robinsons Homes’ sales groups coming from Laoag, East Luzon, Baliwag, Lipa, Tarlac, Palawan, Cebu, Bacolod, Davao, Cagayan de Oro, and Gen San, gathered for an afternoon of inspirational talk, motivational activities and prestigious recognition. Two of the event’s highlights were the awarding of Top Sales achievers and the inspirational message given by Robinsons Land Corporation president Frederick D. Go. The awarding photo shows (l –r) Rookie Property Associate for Fiscal Year 2016 Marilou V. Casanos (receiving on behalf was Ricardo Inting); Quality Sales Awardee Rene S. Recto; Robinsons Homes business unit general manager Cora L. Ang Ley; Robinsons Land Corporation president Frederick D. Go; Top Business Director for Fiscal Year 2016 Alejandro C. Sia; Top Property Associate for Fiscal Year 2016 Archie T. Rustata (receiving on behalf was Samuel Villacencio); Top Division Manager for Fiscal Year 2016 Jessica C. Junio; and Robinsons Homes Sales & Marketing Head Luigi C. Prieto.
